name: Pasta Salad
description: A colorful pasta salad with penne or spiral pasta, vegetables, feta cheese, and a tangy herb dressing.
recipeIngredient: ½ bag penne or spiral pasta

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the pasta according to package instructions, then drain and cool.
Add chopped green pepper, tomatoes, green onions, and sliced black olives to the cooled pasta.
Crumble the feta cheese into the pasta mixture.
Pour the Classic Herb dressing over the salad and toss to combine.

keywords: pasta salad, feta cheese, herb dressing, vegetable salad

_similar.name: Tomato Chickpea Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring chickpeas, diced tomatoes, cucumber, and crumbled feta, all tossed in a tangy herb-infused dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) can chickpeas, rinsed and drained
Dressing: 1/3 cup olive oil, 3 Tbsp white wine vinegar, 1 crushed garlic clove, 1 tsp dried tarragon leaves, 1/2 tsp dry mustard, 1/4 tsp pepper, pinch cayenne pepper

recipeInstructions.text: In a large bowl, combine chickpeas, diced tomatoes, cucumber, green onions, and parsley.
In a small bowl, whisk together the dressing ingredients: olive oil, vinegar, garlic, tarragon, mustard, pepper, and cayenne.
Toss the dressing with the salad ingredients until well coated.
Cover and refrigerate for several hours before serving.

_similar.keywords: chickpea salad, tomato salad, Mediterranean salad, feta cheese

_similar.name: Dad's Spaghetti
_similar.description: A comforting spaghetti dish with bacon, mushrooms, and a creamy mushroom soup sauce.
recipeIngredient: 1 to 2 tsp garlic salt or 1 to 2 minced garlic cloves

recipeInstructions.text: Cook spaghetti, drain, and set aside.
Brown bacon in a frying pan with garlic salt or minced garlic.
Remove bacon and most of the grease from the pan.
Cook onion and mushrooms in the same pan until tender.
Return bacon to the pan and add mushroom soup.
Stir and heat the sauce through, adding cheese and enough water to achieve the desired consistency.
Combine the sauce with cooked spaghetti and serve.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti, bacon, mushroom sauce, creamy pasta

_similar.name: Marinated Vegetable Salad
_similar.description: A colorful and versatile marinated vegetable salad perfect for serving as finger food or a side dish.

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and clean all the vegetables, then drain well.
Break cauliflower and broccoli into bite-sized pieces.
Trim radishes and carrots; leave whole unless large, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
Cut celery into 3-inch pieces and slice cucumber into 1/2-inch slices.
Leave cherry tomatoes whole.
Place all prepared vegetables in a large bowl.
Pour Italian dressing over the vegetables and let set for a few hours.
Serve as finger food or as a salad.

_similar.keywords: marinated vegetables, vegetable salad, Italian dressing

_similar.name: Cornbread Salad
_similar.description: A layered salad with crumbled cornbread, black beans, corn, cheese, and a creamy dressing, perfect for chilling before serving.
recipeIngredient: 1 (11 oz) can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (15 oz) can black beans, rinsed and drained
½ cup salad dressing or mayonnaise
½ cup chopped fresh cilantro or parsley
6 plum or tiny tim tomatoes, shredded

recipeInstructions.text: Prepare cornbread mix according to package directions and let cool. Crumble into pieces.
In a food processor or blender, combine salad dressing (or mayonnaise), lime juice, cumin, and salt. Process until smooth.
Layer half of the lettuce, cornbread, dressing mixture, beans, corn, cheese, red bell pepper, green onions, and tomatoes in a 4-quart bowl.
Repeat the layers, finishing with the remaining dressing on top. Garnish as desired with cilantro or onion curls.
Cover and chill for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

_similar.keywords: Cornbread salad, layered salad, Southwestern salad

_similar.name: Greek Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing Greek salad with marinated tomatoes, mixed greens, feta cheese, and a homemade dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: To Marinate Tomatoes: Cut tomatoes in halves or quarters. Squeeze out seeds and juice and cut into bite-size pieces. Whisk marinade together, stir in tomatoes, and let stand for at least 1 hour.

To Make Dressing: Place garlic, vinegar, and seasonings in a blender and whirl to blend. While still whirling, gradually drizzle in the oil. Add anchovies. Can be used immediately or covered and refrigerated.
To Complete Salad: Mix greens, onions, olives, pepper, and cheese. Add marinated tomatoes. Toss and drizzle dressing over salad. Add croutons if desired.

_similar.keywords: Greek salad, marinated tomatoes, feta cheese, homemade dressing
